description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::from_chars function, specifically testing floating point parsing, rounding, overflow, underflow, NaN handling, and comparison with strtod/strtof. It includes extensive test cases for double and float precision, including edge cases and special values.

methods.name: TestDoubleParse
methods.description: Tests that a string is parsed exactly as the expected double value by absl::from_chars.

methods.name: TestFloatParse
methods.description: Tests that a string is parsed exactly as the expected float value by absl::from_chars.

methods.name: ToFloat
methods.description: Converts a string view to a float using absl::from_chars.

methods.name: ToDouble
methods.description: Converts a string view to a double using absl::from_chars.

methods.name: TestHalfwayValue
methods.description: Tests that values just below and above the halfway point between two floats round correctly.

methods.name: Identical
methods.description: Checks if two floating point values have identical bit layouts, including NaN cases.
